subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Modern Slavery in Supply Chains
description: A short lesson to help you apply Modern Slavery in Supply Chains.

hook.text: 50 million people are in forced labor worldwide. Some of them make products that reach your shelf.

buildup.text: Modern slavery includes forced labor, debt bondage, and human trafficking hidden in global supply chains.

discovery.text: Industries at highest risk: agriculture, garments, electronics, fishing, and construction materials.

twist.text: Laws in the UK, Australia, and California now require companies to report efforts to eliminate slavery.

climax.text: Mapping supply chains to the lowest tiers and auditing labor practices are the first steps to change.

punchline.text: If you sell it, you're responsible for how it was made.

quiz.question: How many people are estimated to be in forced labor globally?
